brand.name: Vorntek
brand.description: Inspection equipment, modular assembly and line integration for industrial production.
brand.descriptionZh: 面向工业生产的检测设备、模块化装配与产线集成。
brand.taglineZh: 让每一道工序，清晰可控。
brand.intro: From a single inspection station to a connected production cell. Vorntek brings equipment, interfaces and engineering support together around your process.
brand.introZh: 从一台检测设备，到相互协同的生产单元。Vorntek 围绕你的工艺，将设备、接口与工程支持连接起来。

name: Inspection & measurement
检测与测量
description: Make a defined inspection task part of the production process.
将明确的检测任务，融入实际生产流程。

name: Assembly & material flow
装配与物料流转
description: Connect people, fixtures and material movement within a working cell.
围绕工作单元，协调人员、工装与物料流动。

name: Identification & data
标识与数据集成
description: Keep product identity and equipment information connected to the process.
让产品标识与设备信息，始终与工艺过程相连。

productLines.name: Inspect vision station
productLines.headline: See the detail that matters.
productLines.headlineZh: 看清工件细节，明确检测结果。
productLines.description: A guarded benchtop cell for camera-based inspection of individual components. A defined fixture, adjustable camera bridge and controlled lighting provide a starting point for a repeatable inspection task.
productLines.descriptionZh: 面向单件零部件的封闭式视觉检测单元。通过定位工装、可调相机支架与受控照明，为可重复的检测任务建立清晰起点。

body: Review sample parts, surface variation and defect examples before selecting the camera, lens and illumination. Acceptance criteria belong to the application.
先核对样件、表面变化及缺陷样例，再选择相机、镜头与照明。验收标准应由具体应用确定。
A fixture plate locates the part beneath the overhead inspection bridge. Tool access and changeover are considered alongside optical positioning.
定位板将工件置于上方检测支架之下，同时考虑光学位置、工具操作与换型。
Agree trigger signals, result handling and the interface to the next station during integration. Throughput is confirmed with representative parts.
集成时确认触发信号、结果处理及下游接口，实际节拍结合代表性工件验证。

specs: Guarded upper cell / lower control cabinet
上部防护单元 / 下部控制柜
faq: What samples are needed?
需要提供哪些样件？
Provide representative good parts, defect examples, surface variants and the proposed inspection criteria. Include drawings where dimensions affect the decision.
提供代表性良品、缺陷样件、表面变化及拟定检测标准。涉及尺寸判断时，同时提供相关图纸。

productLines.name: Measure dimensional bench
productLines.headline: Give measurement a defined position.
productLines.headlineZh: 让测量，从稳定定位开始。
productLines.description: A fixture-based measurement bench with a granite-style reference plate and adjustable instrument column. Organise component positioning, measurement access and the operator's sequence in one station.
productLines.descriptionZh: 以定位工装、基准平台与可调仪器立柱组织测量任务，将工件放置、测量操作与人员作业顺序安排在同一工位。

body: Start with the drawing datum and clamping surfaces. The fixture should locate the part without obstructing the measurement path.
从图纸基准与夹持表面出发，工装既要稳定定位，也应避让测量路径。
Instrument range, resolution and calibration are selected for the application. The bench dimensions do not imply a measurement accuracy.
量程、分辨率与校准要求依据应用选择，工作台外形不代表测量精度。
Review loading, clamping, measurement and unloading as a sequence. Record the result format and any traceability requirements.
将上料、夹紧、测量与下料作为完整顺序核对，同时确认结果格式和追溯要求。

faq: Does the bench specify accuracy?
工作台是否规定测量精度？
Accuracy depends on the instrument, fixture, environment and method. Agree these conditions and verification criteria for the project.
精度取决于仪器、工装、环境与方法，需要结合项目确认条件及验证标准。

productLines.name: Assemble modular workstation
productLines.headline: Build the station around the operation.
productLines.headlineZh: 围绕作业，组织每一处细节。
productLines.description: A steel-frame assembly bench with a tool panel, overhead rail and lower shelf. Bring fixtures, tools and material locations within a clearly organised manual work area.
productLines.descriptionZh: 钢制装配工作台结合工具板、顶部支架与底部层板，将工装、工具及物料位置组织在明确的人工操作区域内。

body: Place fixtures and component bins around the actual operation. Check reach, visibility and the movement of tools with the intended operator.
按实际工序安排工装和料盒，结合使用人员核对取放距离、视线与工具活动范围。
The upright panel and overhead rail provide mounting locations for tools, lights and instructions. Confirm loads and fixing details before use.
立面工具板与顶部支架提供工具、照明和作业说明的安装位置，使用前确认负载及连接细节。
Coordinate the bench with conveyors and adjacent stations. Buffer space and access for replenishment are part of the layout.
与输送模块及相邻工位共同规划，将缓存和补料空间纳入布局。

specs: Tool panel, overhead rail, lower shelf
工具板、顶部支架、底层板
faq: Can the station follow an existing operation?
能按现有工序配置吗？
Share the operation sequence, tooling, component presentation and space restrictions. Review the arrangement with the intended operator before finalising it.
提供作业顺序、工具、物料呈现方式与空间限制，定案前与使用人员共同核对布局。

productLines.name: Convey roller module
productLines.headline: Make the handoff part of the process.
productLines.description: A straight roller-conveyor concept for moving supported trays between workstations. Adjustable guide rails and a simple stand frame help define the transfer boundary.
productLines.descriptionZh: 用于工位间托盘流转的直线滚筒输送模块。导向边界与支撑框架共同定义转运区域，适合纳入单元布局规划。

body: Confirm tray dimensions, mass, centre of gravity and the underside contact surface before choosing rollers and spacing.
选择滚筒与间距之前，先确认托盘尺寸、质量、重心及底部接触面。
Review working height, transfer gaps, stopping positions and replenishment access with adjacent stations.
与相邻工位核对工作高度、交接间隙、停止位置和补料路径。
Drive type, speed and control are project decisions. Manual and powered arrangements require different handling and guarding reviews.
驱动形式、速度与控制方式由项目确定，人工和动力输送需分别核对操作及防护要求。

faq: What determines conveyor selection?
输送选型需要什么信息？
Tray dimensions and underside, maximum mass, target flow, transfer heights and operating environment.
托盘尺寸及底面、最大质量、目标流量、交接高度与运行环境。

productLines.name: Trace identification station
productLines.headline: Keep identity with the part.
productLines.headlineZh: 让标识，跟随每一件产品。
productLines.description: A guarded station layout for applying and checking product identification. A fixture position, overhead device mount and local operator panel organise the marking and reading task.
productLines.descriptionZh: 用于施加与核对产品标识的防护工位布局。定位位置、顶部设备安装架与本地操作面板，共同组织标识与读取任务。

body: Define code content, position and the material surface. The marking method is selected against these inputs.
先定义编码内容、位置与材料表面，再据此选择标识方式。
Consider readability checks and rejected-part handling as part of the same sequence, not an unrelated downstream task.
将可读性核对及不合格品处理纳入同一作业顺序。
Decide which identifier, timestamp and result the station needs to exchange. Confirm ownership and retry behaviour with the line controller.
确认需要交换的标识、时间与结果，并与产线控制方约定归属及重试方式。

specs: Reader and criteria selected per project
按项目配置读码器及标准
faq: Is a marking technology fixed?
是否固定采用某种打标技术？
No. Material, code size, permanence and safety requirements determine the method and the necessary enclosure.
不固定。材料、码尺寸、耐久性和安全要求共同决定标识方式及所需防护。

productLines.name: Connect data acquisition unit
productLines.headline: Bring equipment information into context.
productLines.headlineZh: 把设备信息，放回生产现场。
productLines.description: A compact control-cabinet concept with an operator display, controller space and organised terminal rows. Plan the connection between machine signals and production records.
productLines.descriptionZh: 紧凑控制柜结合操作显示、控制器安装空间与有序端子排，用于规划设备信号与生产记录之间的连接。

body: List available machine signals, their meaning and their update conditions. Separate measured values, derived states and manual entries.
列出设备可用信号、含义与更新条件，区分实测值、推导状态与人工录入。
Protocols, network access and field wiring are agreed with the existing equipment owner. No connection is implied by the display concept.
协议、网络访问与现场接线需要与原设备方共同确定，显示界面本身不代表已建立连接。
Agree timestamp handling, buffering, duplicate prevention and recovery after an interrupted connection before deployment.
部署之前确认时间戳、缓存、重复处理及连接中断后的恢复方式。

specs: Agreed with equipment and IT owners
faq: Can existing machines be connected?
能连接现有设备吗？
First review the available interfaces, documentation, access permissions and required signals. Compatibility is confirmed through a defined integration test.
先核对现有接口、文档、访问权限及所需信号，通过明确的集成测试确认兼容性。

name: Component inspection, from sample to decision.
从样件到判断，组织零部件检测。
intro: Bring part presentation, inspection criteria and result handling together before selecting individual instruments.
先统一工件呈现、检测标准和结果处理，再选择具体仪器。
steps: Review representative samples
核对代表性样件
Collect good parts, defect examples, material variations and the relevant drawing requirements.
收集良品、缺陷样件、材料变化及相关图纸要求。
Arrange the inspection sequence
安排检测顺序
Define fixture access, lighting, measurement points and the decisions required at each stage.
明确工装操作、照明、测量点及各阶段需要作出的判断。
Agree the result boundary
确认结果处理边界
Specify accepted and rejected-part routes, identifier handling and the evidence required for acceptance.
约定合格品与不合格品去向、标识处理及验收需要的记录。

name: A work cell built around the operation.
围绕作业，构建装配单元。
intro: Coordinate the operator, tools and material flow in a clearly defined work area.
在明确的工作区域内，协调人员、工具与物料流动。
steps: Map the operation
梳理作业步骤
List the sequence, tools and component presentation with the people who perform the work.
与实际使用人员一起列出工序、工具及物料呈现方式。
Connect the handoffs
衔接工位交接
Review transfer heights, buffer positions and clear access for replenishment and maintenance.
核对交接高度、缓存位置，以及补料和维护的通行空间。
Validate the complete cycle
验证完整作业周期
Trial the sequence with representative components and record any reach, fixture or timing issues.
使用代表性工件试运行完整顺序，记录取放、定位与时间方面的问题。

name: Integrate the next step into an existing line.
让下一道工序，融入现有产线。
intro: Upgrade a defined section while respecting the equipment, interfaces and operating constraints already in place.
在尊重现有设备、接口与运行约束的前提下，改造明确的生产环节。
steps: Survey the existing line
先核对现有产线
Record the layout, transfer points, controls, utilities and available maintenance window.
记录布局、交接点、控制、能源条件及可用维护窗口。
Agree the interfaces
确认接口与责任
Define mechanical, electrical and information boundaries with the existing equipment owner.
与原设备方明确机械、电气和信息接口的边界及责任。
Prepare the cutover
准备切换与恢复
Plan installation, commissioning, acceptance and the route back to the previous operating arrangement.
规划安装、调试、验收以及恢复原运行方式的路径。
